speaker: richard_burbage
text: For Gods sake let vs sit vpon the ground, and tell sad stories of the death of Kings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. Quieter than I expected. The loss is in the room before a word comes to explain it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I felt the sit before I finished the line. I will not pace it now.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Six lines. I am afraid of each, and I am holding the roll as if it might go off.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say them afraid. The roll will not go off in your hand.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Be afraid of the king, not of the paper. Your six are a boy's fear beside a man's. Do not drop him.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Breathe, and give the cue. Nobody here is waiting to see you fail.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He's a weak king. I'll not play him weak. I'll play him a strong man at being weak. Dost see it? He's the best in England at it. He does it better than my cousin there does winning.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I am the cousin. I heard you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Augustine. That bow is the whole of your answer, and it is enough.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I can win a scene without a noise. He has just shown the room how.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Hold still, Master Burbage. The sleeve wants a pin at the elbow, and I will not have the seam out because you sat down in it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Pin it. I am sat. A king can wear a sleeve and a loss at the same time.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: He means it all, doesn't he? Even the parts he's putting on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the part.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The quiet, and the sit. He has put the loud one down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The loud one was the fight with Bolingbroke. This is the man. When thou come in as the Queen, do not copy the sit. The sit is his.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nothing in the margin. The quiet pass does not need a pen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it empty.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The hired men are in the door. They have left the dice and the apples. Let them stay.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them stay. Let them not help. A noise will not improve it now.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will do the six afraid, and I will keep hold of the roll.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: You have a clove in your cheek, and you still said it plainer than the loud pass.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The clove is the tooth. The line is the morning. Do not mix them.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The sleeve will hold. Stand when the scene lets you, and not before I am clear of the pin.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have the crown in my hands. I can wait for a pin. I sat down on purpose.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have bowed. I am not going to make a speech of a bow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done with the shore for this morning. Kemp was not called, and he is not being called now.
